JOIN lambdas b ON b.lambda_id = i.lambda_id JOIN lambda_active_versions v ON v.lambda_id = i.lambda_id AND (NOT i.is_testing AND v.is_public OR i.is_testing AND v.latest_status = 1)
i.deleted_at IS NULL AND (i.end_date IS NULL OR i.end_date > #{date})
mapper.select:
SELECT i.lambda_assignment_id, v.lambda_version_id, i.location_id, COALESCE(l.timezone, o.timezone) AS timezone, i.schedule_last_date, i.schedule_next_date, v.schedule FROM lambda_assignments i
JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = i.location_id JOIN organizations o ON o.organization_id = l.organization_id WHERE AND v.schedule IS NOT NULL AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.deleted_at IS NULL AND (i.schedule_next_date IS NULL OR i.schedule_next_date <= #{date} OR i.schedule_last_date <= v.schedule_start_date)

SELECT FROM lambda_assignments i JOIN locations l on l.location_id = i.location_id
WHERE i.lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId} AND AND l.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT FROM lambda_assignments i JOIN locations l on l.location_id = i.location_id
WHERE i.location_id = #{locationId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND l.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT l.location_name AS name, COALESCE(l.timezone, o.timezone) AS timezone, l.country_code AS country, l.city, l.postal_code AS postalCode FROM locations l JOIN organizations o ON o.organization_id = l.organization_id WHERE l.location_id = #{locationId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL AND o.deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT d.device_uuid, d.type_id AS device_type_id, d.device_name, ld.location_id, CAST(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM ld.start_date) * 1000 AS bigint) AS start_date FROM location_devices ld JOIN devices d ON d.device_uuid = ld.device_uuid JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = ld.location_id WHERE ld.location_id = #{locationId} AND (ld.end_date IS NULL OR ld.end_date > NOW()) AND l.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY d.device_uuid

SELECT hydration.* FROM ( SELECT 0 AS row_type, lcs.current_state AS location_current_state, NULL::varchar AS device_uuid, NULL::jsonb AS device_current_state, NULL::integer AS user_id, NULL::integer AS location_access FROM locations l LEFT JOIN location_current_states lcs ON lcs.location_id = l.location_id WHERE l.location_id = #{locationId} AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 1 AS row_type, NULL::varchar AS location_current_state, d.device_uuid, dcs.current_state AS device_current_state, NULL::integer AS user_id, NULL::integer AS location_access FROM location_devices ld JOIN devices d ON d.device_uuid = ld.device_uuid LEFT JOIN device_current_states dcs ON dcs.device_uuid = d.device_uuid JOIN locations l ON l.location_id = ld.location_id WHERE ld.location_id = #{locationId} AND (ld.end_date IS NULL OR ld.end_date > NOW()) AND l.deleted_at IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS row_type, NULL::varchar AS location_current_state, NULL::varchar AS device_uuid, NULL::jsonb AS device_current_state, ul.user_id, 0 AS location_access FROM user_locations ul JOIN users u ON u.user_id = ul.user_id WHERE ul.location_id = #{locationId} AND (ul.end_date IS NULL OR ul.end_date > #{date}) AND u.deleted_at IS NULL ) hydration ORDER BY hydration.row_type, hydration.device_uuid, hydration.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_run_results ( part, lambda_assignment_id, lambda_version_id, result_code, lane, request_date, result_message, triggers, events_count, memory, execution_time, processing_time, event_date, server, retries, function_name) VALUES ( #{s.part}, #{s.lambdaAssignmentId}, #{s.lambdaVersionId}, #{s.resultCode}, #{s.lane}, #{s.requestDate}, #{s.resultMessageCompressed}, #{s.triggers}, #{s.eventsCount}, #{s.memory}, #{s.executionTime}, #{s.processingTime}, #{s.eventDate}, #{s.server}, #{s.retries}, #{s.functionName})

INSERT INTO lambda_latest_runs ( lambda_assignment_id, invocation_lane, lambda_version_id, function_name, trigger_count, pending_count, next_input_number, run_id, prev_run_id, invocation_gen, is_started, aws_request_id, aws_log_stream, triggered_at, expiry_date, aws_log_end_date) VALUES ( #{lambdaAssignmentId}, #{invocationLane}, #{lambdaVersionId}, #{functionName}, #{triggerCount}, #{pendingCount}, #{nextInputNumber}, #{runId}, #{prevRunId}, #{invocationGen}, #{started}, #{awsRequestId}, #{awsLogStream}, #{triggeredAt}, #{expiryDate}, #{awsLogEndDate})
mapper.select: SELECT lambda_assignment_id, invocation_lane, trigger_count, pending_count, next_input_number, lambda_version_id, function_name, run_id, triggered_at, expiry_date, invocation_gen, is_started AS started, aws_request_id, aws_log_stream, prev_run_id, aws_log_end_date FROM lambda_latest_runs WHERE lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId} AND invocation_lane = #{lane} FOR UPDATE

SELECT x.lambda_assignment_id, x.invocation_lane, x.lambda_version_id, h.lambda_id, x.run_id, x.triggered_at FROM lambda_latest_runs x JOIN lambda_versions h on x.lambda_version_id = h.lambda_version_id AND h.status IN ('UNDER_TEST','PRODUCTION','DISCARDED','FALLBACK') WHERE x.aws_request_id = #{awsRequestId} LIMIT 1

SELECT x.lambda_assignment_id, x.invocation_lane, x.lambda_version_id, h.lambda_id, x.run_id, x.triggered_at, x.invocation_gen, x.is_started AS started, x.function_name, x.aws_request_id, x.aws_log_stream, x.pending_count, x.next_input_number, x.expiry_date, x.aws_log_end_date FROM lambda_latest_runs x JOIN lambda_versions h on x.lambda_version_id = h.lambda_version_id AND h.status IN ('UNDER_TEST','PRODUCTION','DISCARDED','FALLBACK') WHERE lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId} AND invocation_lane = #{lane}

SELECT x.lambda_assignment_id, i.location_id, x.run_id, x.invocation_lane FROM lambda_latest_runs x JOIN lambda_assignments i ON i.lambda_assignment_id = x.lambda_assignment_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND (i.end_date IS NULL OR i.end_date > NOW()) WHERE x.run_id > 0 AND x.expiry_date < #{expiryDate} AND x.invocation_lane = 'DEFAULT'

SELECT x.lambda_assignment_id, i.location_id, x.run_id, x.invocation_lane FROM lambda_latest_runs x JOIN lambda_assignments i ON i.lambda_assignment_id = x.lambda_assignment_id AND i.deleted_at IS NULL AND (i.end_date IS NULL OR i.end_date > NOW()) WHERE x.run_id > 0 AND x.expiry_date < #{expiryDate} AND x.invocation_lane = 'ASYNC'
mapper.update:
UPDATE lambda_latest_runs SET lambda_version_id = #{lambdaVersionId}, function_name = #{functionName}, run_id = #{runId}, triggered_at = #{triggeredAt}, expiry_date = #{expiryDate}, trigger_count = #{triggerCount}, invocation_gen = #{invocationGen}, is_started = #{started}, pending_count = #{pendingCount}, next_input_number = #{nextInputNumber}, aws_request_id = #{awsRequestId}, aws_log_stream = #{awsLogStream}, prev_run_id = #{prevRunId} WHERE lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId} AND invocation_lane = #{invocationLane}
AND (run_id = 0 OR expiry_date IS NULL OR expiry_date < #{triggeredAt})
UPDATE lambda_latest_runs SET aws_request_id = #{awsRequestId} WHERE lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId} AND invocation_lane = 'ASYNC' AND run_id = #{runId} AND aws_request_id IS NULL

WITH input AS ( SELECT CAST(#{large} AS boolean) AS large, CAST(#{input.data} AS bytea) AS data ) UPDATE lambda_pending_inputs_p SET input_number = #{input.inputNumber}, input_size = #{input.inputSize}, is_large_input = input.large, input_data = CASE WHEN input.large THEN NULL ELSE END, large_input_data = CASE WHEN input.large THEN input.data ELSE NULL END FROM input WHERE (tableoid, ctid) IN ( SELECT tableoid, ctid FROM lambda_pending_inputs_p WHERE part IN (MOD(#{part} + 3, 4), #{part}) AND lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId} AND lane = #{lane} AND input_number < #{nextInputNumber} LIMIT 1)
mapper.insert: WITH input AS ( SELECT CAST(#{large} AS boolean) AS large, CAST(#{input.data} AS bytea) AS data ) INSERT INTO lambda_pending_inputs_p ( part, lambda_assignment_id, lane, input_number, input_size, is_large_input, input_data, large_input_data) SELECT #{part}, #{lambdaAssignmentId}, #{lane}, #{input.inputNumber}, #{input.inputSize}, input.large, CASE WHEN input.large THEN NULL ELSE END, CASE WHEN input.large THEN input.data ELSE NULL END FROM input
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM lambda_pending_inputs_p WHERE (tableoid, ctid) IN ( SELECT tableoid, ctid FROM lambda_pending_inputs_p WHERE lambda_assignment_id = #{lambdaAssignmentId} LIMIT #{limit})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT v.lambda_assignment_id FROM lambda_assignment_vars v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lambda_latest_runs e WHERE e.lambda_assignment_id = v.lambda_assignment_id AND e.invocation_lane = 'DEFAULT' AND e.triggered_at > #{date}) LIMIT #{maxCount}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO lambda_location_vars (location_id, variable_name, update_date, original_size, value) VALUES (#{locationId}, #{name}, #{updateDate}, #{originalSize}, #{smallValue})
mapper.select: SELECT v.location_id FROM lambda_location_vars v WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM lambda_assignments i, lambda_latest_runs e WHERE i.location_id = v.location_id AND e.lambda_assignment_id = i.lambda_assignment_id AND e.invocation_lane = 'DEFAULT' AND e.triggered_at > #{date}) LIMIT #{maxCount}
